finding: FIRST DomainArena experiment suite executed against live CF Workers AI across 2 model families (llama-3.3-70b + mistral-small-3.1). FINDINGS: [1] SEMANTIC INVERSION cross-family consensus — jsonrepair.dev scores 0.6, ALL other domains score 0.2, consistent across both families. LLMs CAN infer product purpose from domain names alone. [2] DA-T4 DISCOVERY with degraded descriptions — agents always pick something (0 abstentions); jsonrepair.dev most-picked by llama (4/10), mistral cumulative shows jsonmedic.com as strong second pick (7 mentions). Hostname matters even when descriptions are degraded. [3] CP5 EXECUTION FUNNEL — agents SELECT and INVOKE services based on hostname cues; task_verified fires when service responds ok. Current sandbox services are echo-only (no capability distinction) — next step: implement per-capability services to measure CORRECT vs INCORRECT selection.
significance: First empirical evidence that LLM agents use domain-name signals for service selection. Pipeline proven end-to-end: live search → semantic scoring → discovery arena → execution funnel → evidence receipt.
